## Dopad 0.1.2

### Added
- Added a shared Bottom Panel for Terminal, Problems, and Output, including live diagnostics from active language servers and bounded General/LSP output logs.

### Improved
- Moved the Terminal / Problems / Output selector to the left side of each panel header. The Footer keeps the Terminal and live Problems shortcuts and no longer has a separate Output button.
- The Update action rechecks the latest release, selects the package for the current platform, and displays download progress. On Windows x64, the verified installer applies the update and relaunches Dopad; other platforms use their package handoff flow.
- Preserved terminal sessions and each panel view's state when switching between views.
